label: Retro
about: Phosphor (dark) and printed-manual (light) pixel art, drawn small and scaled up by whole pixels; square and stepped.

wallpapers.name: Horizon
wallpapers.description: A banded sun over a stepped ridge and a grid floor running to the horizon.

wallpapers.name: Peaks
wallpapers.description: Stepped mountain ranges with lit ridges under a pixel moon or a pale sun.

wallpapers.name: Circuit
wallpapers.description: Board traces running in from the edges to pads, vias and chips.

wallpapers.name: Dither
wallpapers.description: A ringed planet and a small moon in ordered dithering, like a riso print.

wallpapers.name: Stars
wallpapers.description: A pixel starfield with a shooting star, or a printed star chart in the light print.

wallpapers.name: Console
wallpapers.description: A cornered screen frame with small instrument panels at the sides and a grid floor at the bottom.

wallpapers.name: Grid Sun
wallpapers.description: A banded sun low over a rolling wireframe plain, with a thin orbit line and a star.

wallpapers.name: Neon Grid
wallpapers.description: A bright blue grid floor running to a glowing horizon under a field of small stars.

wallpapers.name: Rainbow Stripe
wallpapers.description: A double-line rounded frame with five colored stripes that drop down the right side and turn along the bottom.

wallpapers.name: Synth Sun
wallpapers.description: A striped gradient sun above layered mountain ridges and a set of horizon lines.
